summary: [MM] TC-CS-021: PO success notification does not display generated PO number — AC-6 violated
acText: A unique Standard Purchase Order number is generated and displayed upon successful order submission.
sapActualBehavior: After clicking Order with valid PO data, SAP displays a transient role=alert 'Purchase order has been created.' without the 10-digit PO number. Page navigates to list. PO IS created but number absent from notification.
duplicateSkipReason: CS-6 already exists — logged 2026-05-18 for the same AC-6 violation by TC-CS-021
jiraCommentNote: Re-confirmation comment added to CS-2 on 2026-05-19 noting pipeline re-run confirmed identical SAP behavior
